# Exact dependency contract for the ledger tag-release gate.
# Every dependency the gate installs or resolves is pinned here: the declared
# build/validation tools, their complete transitive set, pip itself, and the
# build-isolation plus wheel-smoke toolchain. The workflow installs every
# tool with -c against this file and exports PIP_CONSTRAINT to it for
# python -m build isolation and scripts/verify_wheel_install.py, whose own
# pip-wheel and venv installs then resolve only under this contract; its
# wheel installation itself is --no-index so no registry resolution remains.
